name: SikaFuko Eco-1
paste:
SIKAFUKO® ECO-1: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaFuko® Eco-1, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikafuko_eco-1.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaFuko® Eco-1 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaFuko® Eco-1 is a re-injectable hose for sealing various construction joints in watertight concrete structures. To seal the joint, SikaFuko® Eco-1 is injected with suitable Sika® Injection materials, such as acrylate and cement suspensions (for multiple injections) or polyurethane resins (for single injection).
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sealing construction joints
    - Suitable for many different structures and construction methods where additional joint security/safety is required
    - Prevents water ingress through concrete joints in the following typical structures: Water retaining or excluding structures, water reservoirs, dams, canals, sewage treatment plants, tunnels, subways, retaining walls
    - As a back-up system for waterbars
    - Enables testing for water leaks
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaFuko® Eco-1
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: PVC Re-injectable Hose For Sealing Construction Joints
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - General Building Inspection Test Certificate, SikaFuko ® Eco-1, MPA NRW, Cert No.P-22-MPANRW-8239
    - Water Tightness Test Report with Sika Injection-306, WISSBAU, No.2002-094-(2)
    - Water Tightness Test Report with Sika Injection-201 CE, WISSBAU, No.2014-158
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - DIN 53505: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shore A hardness (p.2).
    - DIN 53504: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Multiple re-injections with Sika injection acrylate resins or microfine cement suspensions
    - One time injectable with Sika injection polyurethane injection resins
    - Ideal back-up solution for combination with waterstops
    - Easy to secure and install
    - Tested in water pressures up to 10 bar (100m)
    - Suitable for many different structures and construction methods
2.5 Composition.
    | White inner core | PVC |
    | Red outer layer | Foamed plastic |
2.6 Diameter.
    | Internal hose diameter | 6 mm (1/4'') |
2.7 Shore A hardness.
    | White inner core | D 50 +/- 3 |
    | Red outer layer | A 80 +/- 5 (not expanded) |
    Test method printed: (DIN 53505)
    Test method printed: (DIN 53505)
2.8 Tensile strength.
    | White inner core | ≥ 10 N/mm² |
    | Red outer layer | ≥ 10 N/mm² (not expan- |
    | ded) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (DIN 53504)
    Test method printed: (DIN 53504)
2.9 Elongation.
    | White inner core | ≥ 100 % |
    | Red outer layer | > 50 % |
    Test method printed: (DIN 53504)
    Test method printed: (DIN 53504)
2.10 System structure. SikaFuko® Eco-1
    | A | Injection channel |
    | B | White perforated PVC spiral hose |
    | core to support the concrete pressure |
    | C | Foamed plastic outer layer as a seal- |
    | ing membrane and to prevent cement paste penetration during concreting |
    | D | Staggered slot perforations in the |
    | foamed plastic outer layer for the uniform discharge of injection resins |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 48 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.12 Packaging. Combi-pack box containing:
    - 200 m or 50 m SikaFuko® Eco-1 hose
    - 10 m green PVC-hose (Inlet)
    - 10 m white PVC-hose (Outlet)
    - 2 m connecting pipe
    - 4 m heat shrink sleeve
    - 50 closure plugs
    - 1 can of adhesive
    - 1 roll of tape
    - 800 fastening clips
    Accessories
    All accessories including inlet and outlet PVC-hose can also be ordered separately.
    Refer to current price list for packaging variations.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Concrete surface must be clean and all loose materials removed before installing hose and placing concrete.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
    - Reference must be made to the Sika® Method Statement: SikaFuko® VT System. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.
    - SikaFuko® Eco-1 injection hose can also be used in combination with different waterstop profiles: Internally placed expansion joint waterstops, internally placed expansion joint waterstops with lateral steel plates and externally placed expansion joint and construction joint waterstops. Refer to Sika® Method Statement: SikaFuko® VT System or contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use SikaFuko® Eco-1 for sealing expansion / movement joints.
    - SikaFuko® Eco-1 will only seal the joint if injected by suitable Sika® injection materials.
    - Re-injection must be carried out with approved Sika® injection materials.
4.4 Further information.
    - Sika® Method Statement: SikaFuko® VT System

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Shore A hardness: White inner core | D 50 +/- 3; Red outer layer | A 80 +/- 5 (not expanded) (DIN 53505) (DIN 53505)
    - Tensile strength: White inner core | ≥ 10 N/mm²; Red outer layer | ≥ 10 N/mm² (not expan-; ded) (DIN 53504) (DIN 53504)
    - Elongation: White inner core | ≥ 100 %; Red outer layer | > 50 % (DIN 53504) (DIN 53504)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaFuko® Eco-1, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/r/sikafuko_eco-1.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
